text:
Alyssa R: FYI postmortem action sync — we saw the recurring tail-latency spikes during peak writes last night. Need owners for SLO/SLA follow-ups and dashboard work.

Mike C: ack. main idea was a combo of batching config + route-level fallback.

Tara S: I can own dashboard and alert tuning. Will add panels for p50/p95/p99 and error-budget burn rate.

Alyssa R: thanks Tara. can you also add a short 'when to page' calc in the dashboard? our current p99 alert pages too late.

Tara S: yep. planning to make a synthetic that tracks 1m rolling p99 and a burn-rate on the error budget. quick query I'll add: ```query: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))```

Jason L: I'll take owner for the SLO edits and rollout policy. Proposal: tighten p99 target from 600ms -> 450ms for the API-write route, keep p95 at 120ms. Also add automatic fallback to lower-cost model variant when p99 breach sustained >10m.

Mike C: sounds reasonable. can we simulate impact on error budget? want to avoid immediate budget exhaustion.

Alyssa R: good call. Jason, can you run a 7d projection on current burn with proposed SLO? set a canary roll for 10% traffic for 24h.

Jason L: yep. I'll run projection and open a PR with the SLO change + rollout steps. target to have canary ready by Tue EOD.

Tara S: for alerts, I'll add two tiers: info (5m sustained p99 > 400ms) and page (10m sustained p99 > 450ms OR error-budget burn > 0.5%/h).

Mike C: question: should throughput SLO be separate? write-heavy customers are getting throttled during bursts.

Alyssa R: let's add a throughput SLO for the write route: maintain 95th-percentile throughput >= 80% of provisioned capacity over 1h window. If breach, trigger autoscale policy review + customer-facing notice.

Jason L: noted. I'll include throughput SLO text in the PR.

sre-oncall-bot: New actions created: 1) Tara — dashboard + alerts (due 3 days). 2) Jason — SLO edits + rollout plan + projection (due 2 days). 3) Mike — batching config experiment + perf run (due 5 days). 4) Alyssa — customer comms draft if SLA changes (review in 4 days).

Alyssa R: tagging @oncall for visibility :eyes: if any pages come in with the new alert defs, please escalate to Jason.

Mike C: I'll capture the batching experiment steps in the runbook and link to the dashboard panels.

Tara S: small implementation note: I will create the dashboard in the shared 'slo' folder and add a short description w/ signal definitions + paging thresholds.

Jason L: when I open the PR for SLOs I'll include a migration plan for Dedicated vs Hosted customers (different capacity guarantees).

Alyssa R: solid. final ask — add a follow-up sync in 1 week to review canary results and error-budget projection. who can attend?

Mike C: I can.

Tara S: me too.

Jason L: me as well.

Alyssa R: ok blocking calendar invite for next Wed 11am. will include action tracker link.

sre-oncall-bot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: 1746283500 (Wed 11:00). Actions assigned in tracker.

Alyssa R: thanks everyone. keeping this short — updates in the tracker please. :thumbsup:
